analysis: One-way repeated-measures hashing analysis for COSC2539

multiple_testing.omnibus_holm_families: Each omnibus method is adjusted across the three algorithms.
multiple_testing.pairwise_holm_family: All reported pairwise comparisons across algorithms.
multiple_testing.pairwise_confidence_intervals: Two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson intervals with Bonferroni familywise coverage across all reported pairwise comparisons.

methods.minimum_one_way_anova_requirement: Addressed with a one-way repeated-measures ANOVA per algorithm; input size is the five-level within-block factor and block is the subject. This is not an independent-groups one-way ANOVA.
methods.anova_null: All five population mean execution times are equal for an algorithm.
methods.anova_alternative: At least one input-size mean execution time differs.
methods.anova_reference_test: Classical repeated-measures F test with Greenhouse-Geisser corrected degrees of freedom when Mauchly's test rejects sphericity.
methods.anova_effect_size: Partial eta squared; reported as a point estimate.
methods.friedman: Nonparametric repeated-block test on within-block ranks. It addresses rank distributions/systematic rank differences, not equality of arithmetic means.
methods.posthoc: After a Holm-significant Friedman test, exact paired sign tests compare within-block rank direction; ties are excluded. The effect is the probability that size 1 has a lower/faster rank, with a Bonferroni simultaneous exact CI.
methods.posthoc_limitation: These are rank-direction comparisons, not pairwise tests of mean execution time.

preserved_existing_analysis.status: included as a separate, previously generated analysis; not overwritten

per_algorithm.block_handling: complete blocks are included as nuisance block effects; the size test is adjusted for block and linear within-block position

input_size_test.interpretation: The blocked model tests whether any input-size mean differs; it does not identify pairs.

design_based_sensitivity.method: Monte Carlo restricted randomization test using the RCBD F statistic; size labels permuted only within blocks
design_based_sensitivity.assumption: Requires the within-block randomized assignment and independent block randomization to be credible; randomization does not guarantee temporally independent blocks.

residual_normality.test: Shapiro-Wilk on block-, size-, and position-adjusted residuals

residual_variance_by_size.test: Median-centered Levene test on model residuals grouped by input size

pairwise.status: Not performed: residual normality or variance diagnostics did not support parametric pairwise contrasts
pairwise.adjustment: Holm p-value adjustment; Bonferroni simultaneous 95% confidence intervals

limitations: A randomized order reduces systematic treatment-order confounding but does not guarantee independent observations or independent blocks.
Each block is run sequentially in one process; residual temporal dependence may remain.
The restricted randomization test depends on the recorded within-block randomization being implemented correctly.
The position adjustment models only a linear within-block order trend.
The input content is seeded pseudo-random bytes; conclusions generalize to these generated inputs and environment, not all data or machines.
The primary response is elapsed time; very small inputs remain sensitive to Python and timer overhead.
No observations are removed; potential timing outliers require documented investigation rather than automatic exclusion.

limitations: The one-way repeated-measures ANOVA is assumption-limited when residual normality fails; Greenhouse-Geisser corrects sphericity, not nonnormality.
Friedman is rank-based and does not test equality of arithmetic mean execution times.
Pairwise sign tests require blocks to be sufficiently independent; measurements were collected sequentially in one process, so temporal dependence cannot be ruled out.
A significant omnibus ANOVA or Friedman test does not by itself identify which input sizes differ.
No observations are removed, and the analysis does not establish performance or security generalization beyond the measured environment and inputs.
The repeated-measures model does not include randomized position; the position-adjusted model and restricted randomization results remain in the separate existing randomized-block analysis.
outlier_policy: All raw observations retained; none were automatically removed.

reproducibility.note: This module's calculations are deterministic; the existing restricted permutation analysis records its own seed separately.
